title: Product Sans / Geometry
slide_intent: Balance geometric consistency with optical correction so letters remain readable rather than mechanically uniform.
strategic_value: Circular construction can connect Product Sans to Google’s logo while optical adjustments support use as a typeface.
demonstration: A filled and outlined Google logo pair sits beside uppercase C G O Q and lowercase c g o q specimens on blue.
practical_value: Compare the visible shape of round letters with the logo’s geometric basis before copying a perfect circle into every glyph.
